title: Mean of a Rademacher summand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n$ be a vector of real numbers, and choose a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ uniformly. For each coordinate $i$, the mean of $a_i x_i$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued function on the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is distributed according to the uniform measure on $\{-1,1\}^n$
